scope: The wrapper pins complete source mappings and therefore requires a fixture export after client-only changes. Existing limits and required native/auth gates remain unchanged. Review explicit fixture dependencies before allowing reuse in a future packet; no current wrapper/input changes and no token/billing savings claim.
interpretation: The managed fixture harness issues random command identities (RetreatJourneyWorld.NewId), so identical seeds can have different lawful prepared roots despite identical fresh genesis. This comparison is not a same-input determinism test. Reuse requires validating the old prepared journey against unchanged generator/authority dependencies, not assuming each re-export is byte-identical.
